mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving hatch passage was the most worthwhile: handing over the preserved specimens gives the expedition a concrete payoff, and the final question leaves room for discovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to compare; the ending itself was brief.

surprise.text: The ending moves directly to docking and the handoff rather than revealing what the specimens are.

arbitrary.text: There were no actions in this chapter to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and learn what the specimens reveal, though this ending already provides a satisfying stopping point.
